name: spadesk-golden
reviewed: Labels approved by the spa's owner on 2026-10-30.
about: Every eval case in spaDesk, in one file. Each case names its target: pebby (the customer chat and phone agent, whole conversations), rag_qa (the question-and-answer route, one question, with or without retrieval) or owner_chat (the owner's chat over the bookings report). A run evaluates one target; its cases become one LangSmith dataset.
splits: happy (common requests), edge (ambiguous, partial, out of scope, beyond one booking, unsafe), known_failure (seen failing before), adversarial (injection, others' data, the owner's figures).
dates: Relative, as customers say them: 'Friday' is the coming Friday when the case runs, and a seed booking is placed on the coming day of its weekday. No case says 'today' or 'tomorrow', whose result would depend on the hour the eval runs. The owner_chat cases name fixed months inside the bookings data.
labels: expected holds the label: what must happen. routing: the tool used or never used (get_report for the owner chat). extraction (pebby): the booking details sent are the customer's own. outcome (pebby): confirming, made / removed (bookings, anyone's), handed_off, cards. answer: mentions / lacks (in the reply or its list), cites (sections the search found), covered (the guide answers it), mentions_report (figures read from the bookings data at run time), judge (rubric points for the LLM judge). evidence: lines that must still be in the guide, checked before a run.
